nodes.label: Positive funded dust remains claimable

nodes.rationale: Transferable local balances use checked u64.

nodes.rationale: Senior/A/B slices preserve source order and percentages.

nodes.rationale: SealWeights seals checked proportional weights.

nodes.rationale: Probe does not query RPC or claim a user balance/receipt.

nodes.rationale: Local packet fixture records serialized byte limit.

nodes.rationale: Interruption recovery remains executable without admin approval or the original keeper.

nodes.rationale: Active-ticket and closing barriers reject later financial mutations while preserving funded claims and permissionless progress.

nodes.rationale: Saturating cursor bounds keep usize::MAX continuation chunks bounded after partial progress in the host model.

nodes.label: Native SOL round state machine

nodes.rationale: Round loss uses gross deposits and actually paid net payouts; toll remains pending until validated allocation commit.

nodes.rationale: Only owed greater than pot closes a round; maturity, explicit position close, and solvent compound claims do not.

nodes.label: Historical position round validity
nodes.rationale: Positions retain opening-round identity and cannot be claimed from a later round; persistent A/B existence survives advancement.

nodes.label: Round::fund_series_a shared A funding
nodes.rationale: The canonical host operation shares the admission ledger, atomically checks Round/Backer/management partitions, adds 100% cash and grants pinned 124% A entitlement without game P&L or Front-End Load.

nodes.label: record_backer_exists_fixture host setup
nodes.rationale: Named document-referenced fixture setup for historical A/B state; it is not a production financial API or a substitute for canonical Series A funding.

nodes.label: Persistent B history after successful promotion
nodes.rationale: The host model records persistent B history when promotion succeeds, preserving future candidate preference and lifetime state.

nodes.label: Ordered close and promotion phases
nodes.rationale: The model orders allocation, candidate counting, randomness, promotion or skip, reset readiness, and next-round activation.

nodes.label: Deadline expiry with protected cash barrier
nodes.rationale: Expiry may abandon candidate/draw work across allocation and counting, but finalization still requires committed cash.

nodes.label: Exact pending-toll allocation commit
nodes.rationale: Seed and funded credits must equal pending toll escrow exactly; finalization carries the full seed once and promotion adds no cash.

nodes.label: Admission pause and atomic expire-finalize-open composer
nodes.rationale: Pause blocks new positions while recovery remains available; the composer uses one instruction execution time and clones/atomically rolls back unless cash, terminal promotion, and expected-round checks pass.

nodes.label: Canonical participant rows and digest
nodes.rationale: The host model orders one row per owner and exposes bounded slices plus a complete-row SHA-256 digest; deployed page proof remains future work.

nodes.label: Preferred and fallback candidate sealing
nodes.rationale: Preferred candidates are net losers without any native A/B history; fallback includes every net loser, with winning owners excluded.

nodes.label: One bound draw and fixed promotion deadline
nodes.rationale: A close stores one immutable 600-second deadline; timely capture is retained, late results are no-ops, and retries do not reset eligibility.

nodes.label: Fixed-width protocol seed
nodes.rationale: The seed binds cluster, program, round, close, selected set, count, and sealed candidate digest; callers cannot choose entropy.

nodes.label: Provider tuple and request collision binding
nodes.rationale: The host model exercises marker atomicity, provider tuple checks, and deterministic request-address stand-ins; real PDA/CPI authentication is explicitly absent.

nodes.label: Full 64-byte fulfilled output retention
nodes.rationale: The provider probe boundary preserves the full output; the host request hash is not a VRF or account-ownership proof.

nodes.label: Bounded unbiased ordinal mapping
nodes.rationale: At most 64 deterministic counters are sampled with rejection bounds; exhaustion skips promotion without rerolling.

nodes.label: Host model custody and runtime boundary
nodes.rationale: Pending cash and claims remain protected in the model, while Solana account ownership, PDA signer checks, CPI authentication, and provider retention still require SVM/provider proof.

nodes.rationale: A document-referenced Rust model symbol is represented as a document-sourced concept; AST ownership and cross-language calls are deferred to structural extraction.

nodes.label: Deployment signing and funds excluded
nodes.rationale: Deployment, live signing/broadcast, key configuration, and funds remain outside the model/probe scope.

nodes.rationale: The probe checks pinned SDK types, PDA/account metas, full output, decoding, and legacy/v0 serialization; live lifecycle remains unproved.
